overview: List of Papers (fifteen items, 1935-38) on Kwantung military affairs: Dairen air-defense drills and pressured foreign-firm contributions prompting a 1911-treaty protest, plus later Kwantung Army friction with Manchukuo, the South Manchuria Railway, and Tokyo's War Ministry.

subfiles.title: List of Papers: Military Affairs—Kwantung
subfiles.about: A two-page index summarizes fifteen records concerning Dairen air defense and the activities and institutional relationships of the Kwantung Army.
subfiles.summary: Indexes 1935 air-defense drills and Dairen's mayor pressuring foreign firms for funds, prompting U.S. concern over coercion and 1911-treaty violation until Japan disavowed it; later entries cover Kwantung Army-Manchukuo/Railway friction, War Ministry disputes, and army-change rumors.

interest: Shows U.S. pushback against pressured air-defense funding and tracks Kwantung Army tensions with Manchukuo and Tokyo.
